restrictions: The witness is the ordinary collision of the two distinct 128-byte messages in certificates/manifest.json under standard-IV SHA-256 reduced to steps 0 through 30, with FIPS padding and all 256 digest bits.
time_log2 35.95 and preprocessing_log2 35.95 are the same ceiling. The explicit sum in proof.md is 65938214962.660278 target compressions, whose base-2 logarithm is 35.940396, strictly below 2^35.95.

The scored program is a deterministic replay of that stored pair. Its construction cost is the counted run in proof.md Section 5 plus the one instrumented z3 solve in Section 6, not an expected-time formula.

The x-dependent search is charged as the bit-sliced program in proof.md Section 6: 41047 primitive 256-bit operations per 256 trials, and 28116 operations once per group. Bitmap hits, record visits, V6 passes, and completion iterations are charged at the executed counters of the reproduced run, not at a density estimate or an entry cap.

The z3 term charges one successful z3 5.1.0 solve at 8786880984645 retired user instructions times 10 primitive operations per instruction. It is the only score-critical measurement that is not an executed counter or a static operation count.
This package claims no full SHA-256 collision and no 32-round collision. The promoted leader at the time of writing is 37.22.

heuristics.statement: The starting solution used by the counted search was produced by one z3 5.1.0 solve of the yield model in Appendix C, seed 88108363. That process retired 8786880984645 user instructions. Each instruction is charged at 10 primitive operations. The term is 8786880984645 * 10 / 2140 = 41060191517.032707 target compressions and is included in the 35.95 sum.
heuristics.scope: Discovery of the starting solution whose header is Appendix A. The yield-run counters are not part of this premise.
heuristics.extrapolation: The instruction count is a perf_event_open receipt for that process from exec until exit, kernel events excluded. The price 10 is ceil of twice the measured SAT-phase mix mean 4.7973. Plain ALU and moves are priced at 4, 128-bit SSE moves at 16, and unmapped bytes at 256. No multiply or divide was sampled.
heuristics.limitations: The price is a sample, not a callgrind trace of every instruction. At price 25 the sum is still below 2^37.12. At price 52 it is not. A reviewer who substitutes a higher price must recompute the sum; crossing 2^35.95 invalidates this claim.
